column1: # Tests that no hosted runner can run, read by .github/tools/check_e2e_coverage.py.
# One `<test>\t<reason>` line each. A test that runs on some shard, or that a
# workflow names, does not belong here, and the check fails if it is listed.

column2: needs an Android device attached over adb; the android job of ci-linux-e2e.yml runs `mcpp test` on an emulator instead
needs the xim:aarch64-linux-gnu-sysroot payload installed; no hosted shard installs it, and the test skips rather than guesses until the index carries the payload
